The predicate should require pairwise disjointness only on session-identifying cookie names (_gitlab_session, WMF-Uniq, authSession, enwikiSession) or on (name,value) pairs after filtering known constant names. This is a DESIGN-TIME fix for the next packet; the current packet's frozen fail-closed rule was correctly followed.

validity_findings: GATE-C3 FAILURE IS A DESIGN/OPERATIONALIZATION DEFECT, NOT A SUBSTRATE FACT: The frozen predicate 'four fresh jars pairwise disjoint on (name, value)' fails on CAL-POS-1/2/3 solely because servers set constant configuration cookies with identical (name,value) across independent sessions. The derived diagnostic (M-DIAGNOSTIC-SESSION-ISOLATION, research/experiments/EXP-GRAPH-37950584469/derived/session_isolation_diagnostic.json) shows: all shared (name,value) pairs are constant configuration cookies (preferred_language=en; GeoIP=US:CA:San_Jose:37.34:-121.89:v4; NetworkProbeLimit=0.001; WMF-Last-Access=09-Oct-2026; WMF-Last-Access-Global=09-Oct-2026; CentralAuthAnonTopLevel=1); NO session-identifying cookie value (_gitlab_session, WMF-Uniq, authSession, enwikiSession) is shared across sessions; every first request was cookie-free (jar_was_empty_before_request=true for all records). The literal frozen predicate is structurally unsatisfiable on these anchors.

EXTRACTION VALIDITY IS ESTABLISHED BY THE DATA DESPITE GATE-C3 FAILURE: Both independently written extraction paths (P-EXTRACT-A html.parser and P-EXTRACT-B regex/lexer with independent entity decoder) agree on exact per-field value sets and session-scoped verdicts for ALL 4 positive anchors (M-EXTRACT-AGREE-VALUESET=4/4, M-EXTRACT-AGREE-VERDICT=4/4). The canary CAL-POS-1 recovers 16 distinct authenticity_token values under both paths. The reconciliation anchor CAL-POS-2 recovers 5 distinct wpCreateaccountToken values under both paths (directly contradicting the parent's 0 distinct and corroborating Frontier's 3 distinct). CAL-POS-3 recovers 5 distinct wpLoginToken values. CAL-POS-4 correctly yields NO_FIELD for both paths. All 4 negatives yield 0 in-list values. All instrument fixtures pass. NC-PATH-INDEPENDENCE passes (separate source hashes, AST attestation, perturbation invariance).

THE PARENT'S 4/5 ZERO-DISTINCT-VALUE FAILURE IS CONCLUSIVELY AN EXTRACTION DEFECT: The parent's instrument reported 0 distinct wpCreateaccountToken values on CAL-POS-2 while raw bodies varied 4/4 (body_sha256 all distinct). This experiment's dual-path extraction recovers 5 distinct values on the SAME url from the SAME substrate (stdlib HTTP, no JS). Frontier independently recovered 3 distinct values on the same URL. The extraction defect hypothesis (H-MAIN) is supported by the raw evidence; the genuine V16 representation loss hypothesis (F-REPLOSS) is contradicted by the successful extraction of varying tokens from raw bytes.

SUBSTRATE CERTIFICATE (GATE C1, C2, C4) PASSES: M-CERT-ROUTE-OK=4/4, M-CERT-FIELD-PRESENT=3/4, M-CERT-NEG-VALUES-A=0, M-CERT-NEG-VALUES-B=0, M-CERT-BODY-VARIABLE=4/4. The certificate's evidence from EXP-FRONTIER-36306528608 (3 distinct wpCreateaccountToken in 3 sessions, 3 distinct authenticity_token in 3 sessions) is independently corroborated by this experiment's live captures (5 and 16 distinct respectively).

CONDITIONAL PART (II) BLINDNESS TEST: M-N-D1V=3 trials (below the 6-trial threshold), M-N-DECISIONS-D1V=2, but NC-NONDEGENERATE-ESTIMATOR fails because CH-POSTCOND-SEM never fires (0 fire, 15 not-fire) across the full trial population. The point estimate M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V=1.0 with anchor-clustered 97.5% lower bound=1.0 matches the structural prediction, but the gate correctly declares DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V. No architectural claim about channel necessity is licensed.

claim_ceiling: Under the FROZEN decision rule, GATE-C3 failure is terminal MEASUREMENT_INVALID (F-CERT) and NO CLAIM-LEVEL STATEMENT IS LICENSED. The frozen rules explicitly forbid converting a missing/invalid measurement into a scientific negative or positive. However, the RAW EVIDENCE AND DERIVED MEASUREMENTS in this packet ESTABLISH that: (1) the extraction-defect hypothesis (H-MAIN) is correct — the parent's 4/5 zero-distinct failure was an instrument/extraction defect, not genuine V16 representation loss; (2) the credential-free stdlib no-JS substrate CAN expose capability tokens on CAL-POS-1/2/3 (both independent paths recover session-scoped varying values); (3) a redesigned GATE-C3 predicate (pairwise disjoint on session-identifying cookie names only) would pass on these anchors and the downstream GATE E3 would pass, yielding branch EXTRACTION-DEFECT-CONFIRMED with outcome SUPPORTS. The maximum justified claim ceiling for a REDESIGNED packet with a repaired isolation predicate is: C-FRESHNESS may advance from HYPOTHESIS to at most EXPERIMENTAL (per CC-B), bounded to the 4 pinned anchors, K=4 sessions, stdlib HTTP, no-JS substrate (CC-A..CC-F). The conditional blindness result (part ii) remains DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V and licenses no architectural claim.
